title: EVM Measurement
text: Measure error vector magnitude (EVM), 2 inputs, 4 outputs, {Measurement interval} sets Measurement interval source Input; {Normalize RMS error vector by} sets the normalization method Average reference signal, {Average constellation power}, {Peak constellation power}, {Reference signal}, {Reference constellation}, {Custom measurement interval}, {Averaging dimensions}, {Output maximum EVM} sets the option to add max port to output maximum EVM, {Output X-percentile EVM} sets the option to add X% port to output X -percentile EVM, {X-percentile value (%)} sets the value below which X % of EVM measurements, {Output the number of symbols processed} sets the option to add nSym port to output number and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: X%
ports.summary: Value below which X % of EVM measurements fall scalar in the range [0, 100]

params.name: Normalize RMS error vector by
params.values: Normalization method Average reference signal power (default) | Average constellation power | Peak constellation power

params.name: Reference signal
params.values: Reference signal source Input port | Estimated from reference constellation

params.name: Measurement interval
params.values: Measurement interval source Input length (default) | Entire history | Custom | Custom with periodic reset

params.name: Averaging dimensions
params.values: Averaging dimensions 1 (default) | vector of integers in the range [1, 3]

params.name: Output maximum EVM
params.values: Option to add max port to output maximum EVM measurements Off (default) | On

params.name: Output X-percentile EVM
params.values: Option to add X% port to output X -percentile EVM measurements Off (default) | On

params.name: X-percentile value (%)
params.values: Value below which X % of EVM measurements fall 95 (default) | scalar in the range [0, 100]

params.name: Output the number of symbols processed
params.values: Option to add nSym port to output number of symbols Off (default) | On

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation
